ato.description: Analyzes mesh UV usage of textures, rescales UV islands by a perceptual quality algorithm, discards unused texel regions and merges them into texture atlases to maximize utilization while preserving quality. Runs after Modular Avatar and before Avatar Optimizer.
ato.generateAtlasesTip: When enabled, UV islands are repacked into one or more texture atlases. When disabled, whole textures are rescaled and no UV repacking happens.
ato.qualityThresholdsTip: All metrics must pass for a scale candidate to be accepted.
ato.pixelsPerMeterTip: Prevents blurring (min) and waste (max). Clamped by the real size of the island in the original texture.
ato.npotTip: Uses 64px steps instead of powers of two. Formats that require POT (e.g. PVRTC) are excluded.
ato.compressionTip: Applied to generated atlases and fallback textures. Auto picks per platform and pixel content.
ato.mipmapsTip: VRChat requires MipStreaming whenever mipmaps are enabled, so one toggle controls both.
ato.platformOverridesTip: Enable per-platform overrides (PC / Android / iOS). Defaults are read from the current build platform.
ato.whitelistTip: Objects listed here (meshes, materials, textures, animations, GameObjects...) cause every texture they reference to skip all optimization. Textures sharing UVs with a whitelisted texture skip atlasing but still get whole-texture scaling and import settings.
ato.mergeSlotsTip: Only for identical opaque materials on the same mesh when no animation switches them individually.
ato.missingDescriptor: VRC_AvatarDescriptor was not found on the object. The ATO component must be placed on the avatar root that carries VRC_AvatarDescriptor.
ato.multipleComponents: More than one AvatarTextureOptimizer component was found on this avatar (including children). Only one is allowed.
ato.error.noComponent: No AvatarTextureOptimizer component found on avatar root.
